incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: high 5xx/error-rate detected for model serving path /v1/generate (canary pool: redwood/gpt-qa-1.2-quant)
Adele (infra): seeing the alert, grabbing logs and will start triage. tagging @oncall
Matt G: I can pull canary host metrics. initial symptom: 90th p99 latency spike + elevated 500s from model-proxy. Hit rate looks normal.
Sarah L: Confirmed — canary reports 12% 5xx in last 5m, control pool is fine. Canary rollout started ~1930000600 UTC.

Jordan K: anyone roll a model today? I saw a canary rollout earlier but no manual changes from infra team.

Raj P: I kicked off a canary for redwood/gpt-qa-1.2-quant at 1930000580 via rollout service. No manual overrides.

Matt G: sharing logs from a canary instance (scrubbed):
```
2026-03-15T14:00:12Z model-proxy ERROR handler.go:212 response=500 err="kv_cache: invalid token size" req_id=0x7f2a
2026-03-15T14:00:13Z model-runtime WARN quantize.go:88 fallback to fp16
2026-03-15T14:00:15Z model-proxy ERROR runtime_client.go:99 unexpected EOF
```

Adele (infra): kv_cache errors line up with the start of rollout. Could be model artifact mismatch with runtime's expected KV structure.

Sarah L: I pulled canary diffs against baseline. Key differences: model binary size +14%, new KV layout tag "v2_kv" present. Metrics: token generation success rate dropped 11%.

Jordan K: hypothesis A: new model variant uses a different kv layout that our runtime didn't opt-in to, causing runtime_client EOFs and 500s. Hypothesis B: quantization profile mismatch causing fallback thrash and memory pressure -> OOM/EOF.

Raj P: I checked the release metadata: rollout manifest references quant_profile: q4_0_v2 and kv_schema: v2_kv. Our serving runtime in canary is compiled with kv_schema v1 enabled only. That sounds like the issue.

Matt G: capturing timeline: rollout initiated 1930000580, first 5xx at 1930000617, sustained until 1930001300. Canary traffic weight = 5%.

Adele (infra): immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback canary to previous model 2) pin canary to runtime that supports kv_schema v2 3) increase logging and hold traffic while we confirm. Given customer impact is limited (5% traffic but 12% errors), prefer quick rollback. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sarah L: Agree rollback preferred to stop noisy errors. We'll lose canary progress but protect users.

Jordan K: +1 rollback. Raj can you confirm the previous revision id? Also check if any other regions picked up v2 artifact.

Raj P: previous revision id: rev-20260314-37. No other regions have the v2 artifact — only canary pool.

Raj P: running pin check command: `rdwctl model get redwood/gpt-qa --revision=current --show-annotations`

Raj P: output: `revision: rev-20260315-41, annotations: {quant_profile: q4_0_v2, kv_schema: v2_kv}`

Adele (infra): executing rollback via rollout service now: `rdwctl rollout undo --pool=canary --to-revision=rev-20260314-37`

deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id jb-3829). ETA ~2m. Logs will stream to: https://ci.redwood/run/jb-3829

Matt G: watching error rate — starting to drop at 1930001365, p95 latency normalizing.

incident-bot: update: rollback completed at 1930001410, canary now at rev-20260314-37, traffic weight 5%

Sarah L: 5xx rate back down to baseline (<1%) across canary hosts. Good.

Jordan K: note for RCA: model artifacts included kv_schema v2 but runtime didn't have compatibility switch. Need a preflight check in rollout pipeline that validates kv_schema compatibility.

Raj P: +1. Also add a canary runtime capability tag check: `runtime.supports.kv_schema=v2`. Rollout should fail-fast if mismatch.

Adele (infra): quick mitigation checklist for postmortem: 1) revert rollout (done) 2) open follow-up to add capability checks + annotated manifests 3) add regression test in pre-merge that runs a lightweight KV handshake test between model and runtime 4) ensure observability shows kv_cache errors as a distinct alert (avoid noisy generic 500s)

Sarah L: logging of the specific error `kv_cache: invalid token size` will be an indicator — add an eval alert rule.

Jordan K: action owners: Adele — create incident doc and runbook changes; Raj — update rollout pipeline to validate runtime tags; Matt — add log-based alert; Sarah — own RCA writeup with timeline and diffs.

Adele (infra): starting incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/1930001234-canary-rca (will post link when done). Handoff to on-call rotation end at 1930001600 UTC.

ops-runbook-bot: auto-note: oncall handoff recorded, next oncall: Jordan K

Jordan K: acked. I'll coordinate the RCA writeup and schedule a short blameless postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

Matt G: attaching the minimal log dump to the incident doc and the canary diffs. Also saving heap snapshots from runtime for postmortem.

Raj P: PR queued to add manifest capability checks: https://git.redwood/pr/8891 — includes unit tests. Please review.

Adele (infra): final note: customer impact tracked as "limited" (5% of traffic, mostly retries handled by clients). No escalations from support. Closing active paging. We'll use this thread for RCA coordination and timeline building. :white_check_mark:
